To: #announcements
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: Linden Pantry Charity Stream — Nov. 21

Hey everyone! Posting this early so nobody misses it this time: last year we raised $212, but a lot of people didn’t hear about the stream until the day of. Let’s see what we can do with a little more notice 💜

On Saturday, Nov. 21, I’ll be streaming for the Linden Community Pantry from 10 a.m. to 10 p.m. Donations go straight to the pantry—nothing gets taken out—and through their wholesale partner, every $1 provides about 4 pounds of food. They’re serving around 340 families a week, and their shelves are especially low before Thanksgiving.

Our goal is $600, and Rook is matching the first $100 donated, so those first donations count twice. Even $3 helps, but please don’t feel bad if you can’t give. You can still join the stream, hang out, share the link, or donate canned and boxed food in the blue bin by the pantry’s side door on Saturdays from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. No card? You can help that way too.

And to be fair to the “charity streams are cringe” take: I get why asking for donations can feel awkward. This isn’t a guilt trip—just a chance to do something useful together, with some ridiculous stream incentives attached. At $100 I’ll play a full round with the controller upside down; at $250, chat picks my hair dye color and I do it on stream (so yes, there’s hair-dye content involved); at $400, chat picks the songs for an hour; and at $600, I’ll vlog a grocery pickup arranged by the pantry.

We’ll start with community lobbies—everyone can join, and I’ll drop the code. For the second half, chat votes on the game every two hours. No repeating maps, Larry, I promise.

Hope you can make it for any part of the day. Pinning this so it’s easy to find—thanks for showing up however you can!
